steps.title: Analyze Build Configurations
steps.description: Inspect app/build.gradle and search for illegal external third-party library references.

steps.title: Remove Third-Party Dependencies
steps.description: Purge nanohttpd dependency from the build configuration block to align with native SDK constraints.

steps.title: Migrate Packaging Block
steps.description: Modernize the legacy packagingOptions configuration block to the newer packaging standard supported by AGP 8.3.2 and Gradle 8.5.

steps.title: Optimize Option Buttons in Quiz View
steps.description: Update GridLayout options buttons inside activity_main.xml to use android:layout_gravity for robust, responsive rendering on all screen sizes.

steps.title: Verify Android Manifest Namespace
steps.description: Validate the XML namespace declaration at the root of AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Verify Activity Declarations
steps.description: Confirm that MainActivity is registered correctly with the platform-defined MAIN and LAUNCHER intent filters.

steps.title: Audit SDK Compatibility in MainActivity
steps.description: Check text-to-speech calls and graphics rendering APIs to ensure full native compatibility with API level 21.

steps.title: Audit Touch Input Performance
steps.description: Confirm that the custom DrawingView implementation overrides performClick properly for accessibility conformance.

steps.title: Clean Gradle Project Cache
steps.description: Clear out any stale compilation artifacts to guarantee a clean build state.

steps.title: Building Alphabet Explorer
steps.description: Compile the purified Java codebase and package the resources into a clean debug APK.
